description: Look up a Romanian company by name or CUI (tax code) in the official ONRC registry of 4.2M firms. Diacritic-insensitive ('paval' finds 'PAVAL'); a CUI matches exactly. The first call for a named Romanian company. Ranked with a score: live firms first (exact name, then words), closed ones after; county lifts. For 'firms that do X in Y', use lookup_by_category (an empty result may carry a hint naming it).

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount).
compact.title: Compact

county.description: Optional county hint (diacritic-insensitive): firms registered there rank higher. Not a filter.
county.title: County

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

max_results.description: Maximum number of companies to return (1-100, default 10).
max_results.title: Max Results

query.description: Company name or CUI (tax ID) to search for. Names are diacritic-insensitive ('paval' finds PAVĂL); a CUI ('2816464', 'RO2816464') matches exactly.
query.title: Query

name: lookup_business

outputSchema.description: Ranked companies for a name, or the firm with that CUI.

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

county.description: The county hint, if one was given.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

fields.description: The company fields kept when fields or compact trimmed the rows.

found.description: false when a well-formed CUI is not in the snapshot.

hint.description: When a name search finds nothing but reads like a category question: the lookup_by_category call that answers it.

items.description: A company record: companyName, cui, registrationCode, registrationDate (DD/MM/YYYY), legalForm, euid, address, county, city, website, phone, caenActivities [{code, activity}], directors, status [{code, name}], latestFinancials {year, revenue, netResult, employees; RON}, anaf {mainCaen, vatPayer, eFactura, inactive}, risk {level, label, reasons, isLead}, source, asOf, and score/match on name searches. With fields or compact, only the requested keys.

source.description: Data source: onrc (registry) or mfp (Ministry of Finance filings).

warnings.description: Notes on how the request was read (a clamped limit, a widened CAEN code, an ignored field).

title: Look up a Romanian company
